resources.string: Sign in with the email on your business card.
Enter the email on your business card. We\'ll email you a 6-digit code.
We emailed a code to %1$s. Enter it and choose a password. Check spam if you don\'t see it.
Sign out of Getmeds Card on this phone?
You\'ve been signed out. Please sign in again.
Your card has no link yet, so it can\'t be shared. Ask the admin to set it in the Studio.
Which card do you want to share?

Online ID: the QR opens your card on getmeds.ph, where they can save your contact. They need internet.

Offline ID: the QR holds your contact itself, so their phone adds it straight away. No internet needed on either phone.

The app picks Online ID when your phone has internet and Offline ID when it doesn't. You can tap either one yourself.

You can also hold phones back to back instead of scanning, if your phone has NFC.
Hold the back of their unlocked phone against yours. My card opens on their phone. On iPhone, they tap the notification that appears.
Turn on NFC to also share by tapping phones. The QR works either way.
Scan to open my card on getmeds.ph
Scan to add my contact. No internet needed.

1. Open your phone camera and point it at this QR.
2. Tap the link that appears.
3. On the card page, tap Save to contacts.
4. Tap Save.

1. Open your phone camera and point it at this QR.
2. Tap the contact that appears (View).
3. If it asks to add to an existing contact, tap Create New Contact.
4. Tap Save.
Opens your card on getmeds.ph. They need internet.
Goes straight to their contacts. No internet needed.
Hold the back of their unlocked Android phone against yours to send your contact. iPhones can\'t receive a contact by tap; let them scan the QR.
Having a problem with the app or your card? Send a ticket to the developer. We\'ll reply to %1$s.
Tell us what happened and what you expected.
Screenshots, photos or PDFs that show the problem. Up to 5.
Tell us what\'s wrong in the message box.
You can attach up to %1$d files.
Some files couldn\'t be attached. Use photos, screenshots or PDFs under 3 MB.
The attachments are too big together. Remove one or two.
The app closed unexpectedly recently. The technical details of that will be added to your ticket to help us fix it.
Your ticket number is %1$s. The developer will reply to %2$s.
